gates.name: sandbox
gates.run: for s in $(git diff --name-only "$BASE"...HEAD -- skills/ | cut -d/ -f2 | sort -u); do d=skills/$s/evals; [ -x "$d/sandbox.sh" ] || continue; for id in $(jq -r '.evals[].id' "$d/evals.json"); do t=$(mktemp -d); "$d/sandbox.sh" setup "$t/sandbox" "$id" >/dev/null; rc=$?; rm -rf "$t"; [ $rc = 0 ] || { echo "$s eval $id: sandbox.sh setup failed (exit $rc)"; exit 1; }; done; done
